<function name="Start" parent="timer" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Restarts the given timer.

<warning>Timers won't advance while the client is timing out from the server.</warning>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="identifier" type="any">Identifier of the timer.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
